notes: 0.22: a calmer screen — layers tucked into one Layers button, Show and Arrange moved into Settings, fewer buttons at rest. Settings › Look & layout: Calm, Standard and Analyst looks, save your own, with live text size, density, glass, motion and layout per posture. Every card now works the same way: a trail, a back button and Next suggestions (learned on this device only; 'interest reset' forgets them). Tap a star in the 3D sky to open its catalog card. The catalog brings 3,674 credited stories from many cultures (each with its licence), plus Explain: how names like Tuesday travelled, step by step with sources. Planets show their real reflected colours; Lilly's colours are an opt-in tradition lens.
